_comment: description is the only field that gets embedded. It carries the words a customer would actually use -- hot, iced, strong, sweet, milky, no milk -- because the product name almost never does. Prices and stock live in metadata and are read fresh at render time, so a price change or a sold-out flag never costs a re-embed.
